title: Classify the admissible quotient kernels of the #4596 word: 32 of 511 pass, v = 153 beats 511 (no new κ)
body:
## Result

**Finite certificate with a scoped proof. No κ is claimed.** This answers the open question in #4596's `PROOF.md`, "Whether `511` is the unique removable direction", for the check #4596 ships. The answer depends on the condition:

- **Under the shipped literal replay, 32 of the 511 directions pass.** They are exactly the directions outside the eight centre hyperplanes of the base word. Those hyperplanes have normals {7, 25, 42, 52, 76, 82, 97, 127}, of GF(2) rank 4, so the passing set is a coset of a 5-dimensional subspace. The other 479 directions all fail the same shipped check, "Paid rank and source frame".
- **511 is not the best of them.** v = 153 has main widths {7: 168, 8: 56} against {7: 112, 8: 112}, local deficit 1688 against 1744, and rank surplus 3776 against 2768. Its complex supplier saving is 0.016567169219 against 0.012091850234, 37% higher. #4596's invoice and screen are applied unchanged.
- **No kernel of dimension 2 or more passes.** The passing coset does not contain 0, so it contains no subspace.
- **Under the geometric condition, 511 is unique.** 511 is the only direction outside all 112 dim-8 main finals, whose normals have full rank 9. That is the condition #4596's construction meets; the shipped replay does not check it.

## Conditions

- **#4596 is open.** The quotient, the helper re-padding and the invoice are DaysSky's. If #4596 is not accepted, this classifies an unaccepted construction.
- **#4604 applies here too.** pinterbanget's open #4604 shows that the shipped replay compares final frames with the word's own record, not with required output charts. The 32 directions pass that same replay. If output charts are part of the supplier contract, none of the 32 words, 511 included, meets it.
- **The outer κ does not move.** #4596's outer κ is limited by the BIT side, so a larger complex saving changes nothing until the BIT admission chain moves.

## Evidence and reproduction

`research/quotient-kernel-family/`. `quotient.py` builds the PR4470 base word and the quotient words from pinned main packages; `verify.py` checks them with the shipped evaluators. From the repository root:

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/quotient-kernel-family/verify.py                  # 31 s
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/quotient-kernel-family/verify.py --scan 1 255     # 106 s
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/quotient-kernel-family/verify.py --scan 256 511   # 105 s
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/quotient-kernel-family/verify.py --physical 153   # 136 s
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/quotient-kernel-family/verify.py --physical 511   # 120 s
```

Times are local (macOS, CPython 3.12).

- **Default run:** derives the centre and main-final hyperplanes from the word. It checks the rank-4 coset, its closed form `{h + 128i + 256j}` and the pair condition. It then replays all 32 predicted directions (632/632 endpoints, both orientations, owned C cleared), checks the declared 153 and 511 profiles, and confirms that four controls are rejected.
- **Scan shards:** replay every direction and require exactly the predicted set to pass.
- **`--physical`:** lowers every realised transport exactly. It requires Fourier rank to equal the absolute dimension difference, the convention of `native_extensions.py:127` and `verify_buffers.py:151`. Result: 2102 edges for 153 and 1865 for 511, 0 mismatches.

Local: `scripts/research_package.py --package research/quotient-kernel-family` and `scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/quotient-kernel-family --check-source-history` both pass.

## Limitations

- One fixed base word and one quotient map family.
- The saving uses #4596's float bisection. A directed-rounding recomputation agreed to 2·10⁻¹⁷ (153) and 7·10⁻¹⁷ (511); it is not shipped.
- The 479 rejections all come from `synthesize` charging every centre transport rank 8. A pipeline that recomputes centre ranks would accept a different set; that is not studied.
- Lowering was checked for 153 and 511 only. There is no formal proof, Lean or selected-construction replay.

## Open next questions

- Does an operator-level endpoint check (#4604's open question) accept any of the 32 words?
- Which kernels pass if centre ranks are recomputed, and does any beat 153?
- Does #4596's controller strictification hold with controller targets from a quotient word? An unverified local substitution gave a negative delta-row margin for all 32 directions, 511 included. This needs an independent check before any outer κ is claimed for the family.

## Related open work

- #4596 (DaysSky): the construction this extends. It uses 511, which is among the 32 here; its published deficit 1744, surplus 2768 and saving 0.012091850234 reproduce exactly.
- #4604 (pinterbanget): an endpoint-frame audit of #4596. It is a different check that applies to all 32 directions; there are no overlapping numbers.

## Credit

This package was produced by Nick Petalas. The quotient construction, re-padding and invoice are DaysSky's (#4596). The base word is Cinna Davis's: #4441, #4447 and #4470, on zxv's native supplier. The endpoint question is pinterbanget's (#4604).

## CI notes

Run [39769931034](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39769931034) on head `b5d71c724`: `plan` failed and `replay` was skipped, so hosted CI has not certified this package.

The failure is not in this package. The "Onboarding helper tests" step fails 4 tests in `tests/test_research_current_status.py`:

- `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`
- `test_current_section_matches_selected_record`
- `test_history_banner_precedes_historical_sections`
- `test_only_the_first_heading_claims_current_or_selected`

The same 4 fail locally on `origin/main` `f626db5c3` (`python3.12 -B -m unittest tests.test_research_current_status`: 6 run, 4 failures). They also fail on other contributors' PR runs since at least 08:19 UTC today, e.g. runs 39754840618 and 39746873103.

The local results in the Evidence section stand.
